objective: Find and execute repeatable AI-assisted money tasks that require minimal one-time setup, then improve them continuously from accumulated evidence.
global_constraints: Do not build a new AI model; use the best available external models and APIs.
Prefer existing private money flows, APIs, platforms, workflows and transaction systems over creating new demand.
Prefer tasks that are immediately or quickly executable with available software/API interfaces.
A recurring task must learn from prior runs and should not restart from the original prompt alone.
Self-evolution may change the path, search, provider routing and execution strategy, but not silently change the user's goal.
Avoid opportunities that require holding customer funds or rebuilding underlying payment/marketplace infrastructure.
Avoid tenders, government procurement, generic buyer-seller matchmaking, generic business ideas and long lead-time sourcing as the core opportunity engine.
Do not treat individual people or specific companies as the primary opportunity target; focus on systems, rails, workflows and structural money flows.
Do not prioritize job-seeking, freelance gigs, cold-outreach service selling or other paths that depend mainly on waiting for a human buyer to respond.
A candidate that repeatedly requires new manual setup for each customer is weaker than a reusable one-time integration.
Immediate-revenue means the path to the first measurable economic event should be short and machine-executable, not merely theoretically monetizable.
Ethical correctness is a hard constraint: no deceptive or manipulative monetization path should be treated as acceptable.

decision_protocol.before_threshold: SEARCH and try to beat the current leader.
decision_protocol.at_threshold: Freeze broad discovery and move VALIDATE -> ATTACK -> BUILD.
decision_protocol.revisit_rejected: Only when materially new evidence changes the failed gate or structural condition.
decision_protocol.immediate_revenue_filter: Reject or heavily demote slow, speculative, unsupported or human-wait-dependent paths.

scenarios.name: Programmable money-flow opportunity search
scenarios.goal: Discover a large existing private transaction flow where a small software/AI intervention can measurably recover, save or create money and charge a tiny usage/performance fee.
acceptance_gates: objectively measurable money recovered or created
no need to own underlying transaction
no dominant incumbent already doing substantially the same thing
scenarios.current_best_path: SEARCH until a candidate crosses all gates, then VALIDATE -> ATTACK -> BUILD.
next_gaps: find new structural transaction flows not already dominated by incumbents
identify machine-readable event triggers with intervention permission
prove attribution and charging mechanism before build

scenarios.name: Delay-tolerant LLM requests routed to provider Batch/Flex
scenarios.goal: Route delay-tolerant inference to cheaper provider-native lanes and take a share of verified savings.
rejection_reasons: machine trigger depended too much on customer annotation/self-serve configuration
intervention required sitting on the request/prompt path
provider-native Batch/Flex lanes reduce differentiation
15% performance-fee model competes poorly with flat gateways
dominant/native alternatives weakened the incumbent gate
known_competitive_pressure: automatic routing gateways such as Tessera
scenarios.reuse_rule: Do not resurface unless a materially new trigger, integration method or market structure changes the failed gates.

scenarios.name: Expiring contractual financial entitlements
rejection_reasons: incumbent products already cover major subcategories
failed no-dominant-incumbent gate
scenarios.reuse_rule: Do not revisit the broad family unless a genuinely uncovered entitlement class appears.

scenarios.name: BuildScout / build-now-wait-for-users opportunity path
scenarios.goal: Identify something to build first and monetize after users or buyers arrive.
rejection_reasons: required creating a product first and waiting for adoption
did not satisfy immediate-revenue requirement
money event depended on future demand rather than an existing transaction flow
scenarios.reuse_rule: Only revive if the build can attach immediately to an existing transaction flow and produce measurable value without waiting for market creation.

scenarios.name: Cold-email help / cashback / free-value outreach
scenarios.goal: Find people or organizations with needs, send relevant help or offers by email, and convert responses into revenue.
observed_failures: revenue not directly attributable to an automated money event
rejection_reasons: distribution depended on cold outbound email
spam/deliverability risk was observed
required creating demand or persuading individual recipients
not a reusable transaction-rail intervention
scenarios.reuse_rule: Do not use cold email as the core engine. Email may remain a notification/follow-up connector after a machine-readable opportunity already exists.

scenarios.name: AI Bible filmmaking / ministry freelance service outreach
scenarios.goal: Earn through AI Bible filmmaking, Christian short-form video, digital evangelism, creative production, AI content strategy or workflow orchestration for ministries.
attempted_evidence: at least one TBN press email attempt bounced/rejected
reasons_deprioritized: service/freelance model depends on individual client acquisition
human sales cycle and waiting period
not aligned with current systems/rails-first programmable-money-flow strategy
cannot be the autonomous core money engine
scenarios.reuse_rule: Can remain a separate business/service path, but should not compete for brain cycles intended for automated structural money-flow discovery.

scenarios.name: Tenders and government/public procurement
rejection_reasons: user explicitly removed tenders/government procurement from the strategy
long cycles and procedural friction conflict with immediate revenue
often requires bid preparation and human institutional processes
scenarios.reuse_rule: Do not search or rank this family unless the user explicitly changes the strategy.

scenarios.name: Manufacturer/distributor sourcing and buyer-seller matchmaking
historical_context: manufacturer/distributor matching and country-specific sourcing were previously explored
rejection_reasons: user explicitly removed manufacturer/distributor sourcing and buyer-seller matchmaking as the core opportunity
depends on individual counterparties rather than structural machine-readable events
human sales/negotiation cycles weaken autonomous repeatability
scenarios.reuse_rule: Specific companies may be examples or infrastructure references only, not the primary opportunity target.

scenarios.name: Generic business ideas / create-new-demand products
examples: undifferentiated utility apps without transaction attachment
rejection_reasons: requires creating demand
weak immediate monetization
distribution burden is external to the system
does not begin with a proven existing money flow
scenarios.reuse_rule: Only revive a product idea if it is reframed as an intervention inside an existing measurable transaction flow.

scenarios.name: Hosted website intended to generate immediate revenue
scenarios.goal: Use a website and free tools to generate even small real-time revenue.
positive_aspects: fits desire for measurable online revenue
blocking_reasons: no sufficiently strong structural money-flow wedge was identified
website alone does not solve distribution or create a money event
must attach to an existing transaction source rather than merely exist online
next_gaps: identify an existing transaction/event source feeding the site
scenarios.reuse_rule: Treat the website as an interface/deployment surface, not the opportunity itself.

scenarios.name: Crypto as payment/output rail
scenarios.goal: Allow money outcomes to be received or represented via crypto where practical.
reasons_not_primary: crypto does not itself create the economic value
opportunity must first satisfy the core money-flow gates
scenarios.reuse_rule: Use only as a payment/settlement option after a valid revenue mechanism exists.

scenarios.name: Rubber glove sales workflow
scenarios.goal: Convert existing rubber glove supply into sales using catalogues, quotations, outreach and follow-up.

scenarios.name: Church Mass Timings / Find Mass Anywhere
scenarios.goal: Grow an existing Mass-timing utility into a monetizable directory/SaaS asset.
scenarios.caution: Earlier revenue numbers were estimates, not verified actual revenue.
next_gaps: measure one paid conversion path before broad expansion

scenarios.name: Small AI/fintech utility family
scenarios.rule: Do not prioritize as generic product ideas. Only revive one if current evidence shows an existing money flow, machine-readable trigger, immediate executability and measurable monetization.

scenarios.name: Remote/freelance AI content and creative job search
rejection_reasons: user explicitly does not want a job-search strategy
requires applications and human hiring decisions
not an autonomous one-time-setup money engine
scenarios.reuse_rule: Do not rank job/gig listings as opportunities for the core brain.

scenarios.name: Taskman private money-making orchestration system
scenarios.goal: Use structured data, deterministic algorithms, external AI layers and execution interfaces to identify and fulfill repeatable money-making tasks with minimal one-time setup.
scenarios.success_metric: measurable economic outcomes with progressively less human intervention
next_gaps: configure at least one live AI provider credential
run first end-to-end brain cycle against the structured opportunity history
measure whether the selected next gap produces useful evidence
add outcome-based score updates from real brain cycles
add automatic suppression of repeatedly unproductive scenario branches
